rules: Every occurrence binds actual font dictionary/effective Encoding, encoded byte, text event, context and page; each class binds its embedded outline.
Source CMEX bytes 50–55 are six square-bracket components, calibrated to corresponding Unicode pieces without merging the assembled bracket.
Own CMEX printable parenthesis alias at braceleftBigg is a visible brace; control-byte parentheses and printable sum aliases are calibrated individually.
Blackboard Z and script U are actual outline-based repairs, not global letter substitutions.
The mapsto tail is U+22A2; the adjacent right arrow remains a separate unchanged event. Negation overlays and operators likewise remain separate.
All36 dictionaries/871 classes use actual Type1 outlines; no Type0 fallback or unembedded-font exception.
Generated extraction whitespace is tracked separately from actual encoded glyph events. No visible whitespace glyph is dropped.
Ordinary decoded ligatures, source spelling/math errors and printed hyphens remain unchanged; NFC/NFKC are distinct sensitivities.
